title: The Lantern at the Edge of the Wood

commands.speaker: narrator
commands.text: The path wound through the ancient wood, dappled light filtering through leaves that whispered secrets to each other.

commands.speaker: mara
commands.text: Mara paused at the fork, her lantern casting long shadows across the mossy stones beneath her feet.

commands.speaker: old_man
commands.text: An old man sat on a stump, whittling a piece of wood. He looked up as she approached and smiled warmly.

commands.speaker: mara
commands.text: "I'm looking for the village beyond the ridge," Mara said, holding her lantern higher to see his face.

commands.speaker: narrator
commands.text: A gust of wind swept through the clearing, and for a moment the lantern flickered as if it might go out entirely.
